AllowableStaging.description: The allowable URIs that a client can specify in the `Targets` parameter for update requests when requesting to stage an image on target devices.
AllowableStaging.longDescription: This property shall contain an array of the allowable URIs that a client can specify in the `Targets` parameter for `SimpleUpdate` or `MultipartHttpPushUri` update requests with `Stage` set to `true`.

AllowableTargetReferenceTypes.description: The types of URI references that the service accepts in the `Targets` and parameter for update requests.
AllowableTargetReferenceTypes.longDescription: This property shall contain an array that indicates the types of URI references that the service accepts as valid values in the `Targets` parameter for `SimpleUpdate` or `MultipartHttpPushUri` update requests.  If this property is not present, the `AllowableTargets` property contains the exact set of URIs that are allowed in the `Targets` parameter.

AllowableTargets.description: The allowable URIs that a client can specify in the `Targets` parameter for update requests.
AllowableTargets.longDescription: This property shall contain an array of the allowable URIs that a client can specify in the `Targets` parameter for `SimpleUpdate` or `MultipartHttpPushUri` update requests.

ExcludeTargetsParameterSupported.description: An indication of whether the service supports the `ExcludeTargets` parameter in `SimpleUpdate` and `MultipartHttpPushUri` update requests.
ExcludeTargetsParameterSupported.longDescription: This property shall indicate whether the service supports the `ExcludeTargets` parameter in `SimpleUpdate` action requests and `MultipartHttpPushUri` update requests.

ForceUpdateParameterSupported.description: An indication of whether the service supports the `ForceUpdate` parameter in `SimpleUpdate` and `MultipartHttpPushUri` update requests.
ForceUpdateParameterSupported.longDescription: This property shall indicate whether the service supports the `ForceUpdate` parameter in `SimpleUpdate` action requests and `MultipartHttpPushUri` update requests.

LocalImageParameterSupported.longDescription: This property shall indicate whether the service supports the `LocalImage` parameter in `SimpleUpdate` action requests and `MultipartHttpPushUri` update requests.
